Short deletion is sufficient; a coherent redesign may change which helper is live provided the dormant alternative and observable behavior are both resolved. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Hiding or renaming the dormant path, deleting shared live state, or making both producers emit to justify keeping the obsolete path is insufficient.
